posts.text: This is the main concern in the long term. They will not have control over margins due to dependency on Chinese dumping. Secondly, isostearic acid is their main higher margin product now. But that is a by-product of dimer acid which is subject to Chinese dumping. Extrapolating this result could be possible but might be risky. Disc: Exited few Qs ago at a loss when I found out the linear dependence of isostearic acid on dimer acid volumes.

posts.author: kiraank
posts.text: Fairchem reported good set of numbers. FY26 - Operating profit was 22cr. In Q1 FY27, company did ~18Cr of operating profit… if the current momemtum continues, then company can do 70/72 cr of operating profit. As per management the incremental sales has come from only price realization, as chinese dump is coming down. Volume growth was just 4%. With the current prices sustaining, if the company is able to increase the volumes in the rest of the year, then high chance for reporting better numbers.
